english.title: Possess salmon/trout/instrument/explosives/poison to fish for freshwater fish in Tweed district except by rod and line
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obtained possession of

(A)_[salmon]_
(B)_[trout]_
(C)_[an instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..),]_
(D)_[explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVES..),]_
(E)_[a poison or other noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY POISON OR NOXIOUS SUBSTANCE..),]_

(F)_[as the result]_
(G)_[for the purpose]_

of

(H)_[fishing for or taking]_
(I)_[attempting to fish for or take]_ (J)_[doing an act preparatory to the fishing for or taking of]_

freshwater fish in inland waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT..), except by rod and line
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 23 and 30 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
